facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; Singapore has no exchange controls.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: hold foreign-currency accounts in Singapore and abroad.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways like HitPay and PayNow QR weren't researched yet.
facts.L1_registration: Register a sole proprietorship with ACRA via BizFile+ ($100 a year).
facts.L2_tax_id: NRIC or FIN for individuals; businesses use the UEN from ACRA.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Business carried on in Singapore is taxed at 0–24%, even for foreign clients.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 9% GST above S$1 million a year; many overseas services are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: PDPA: appoint a data protection officer; fines up to S$1 million.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No general cooling-off for online purchases; returns follow the seller's policy.

watch_out.text: Keep MediSave contributions up to date, or ACRA won't renew your registration.
The foreign-income exemption doesn't cover freelance work done in Singapore.
